tasks.title: Confirm launch date with sponsors
tasks.description: Agree the go-live date and write it down in the launch note.
checklist: Ask sponsor for two candidate dates
Check the date against the release calendar
Publish the date in the team channel

tasks.title: Draft customer announcement
tasks.description: One page, plain language, no feature we cannot show on day one.

tasks.title: Freeze the release branch
tasks.description: No feature work after the freeze, only fixes that the release manager approves.

tasks.title: Run the load test against staging
tasks.description: Target: the traffic we expect in the first launch week, with a safety margin.

tasks.title: Fix the three open blocker bugs
tasks.description: Only the bugs tagged blocker in the tracker.

tasks.title: Brief the support team
tasks.description: A 30 minute walkthrough plus a one page FAQ.
checklist: Send the FAQ a day before

tasks.title: Go / no-go meeting
tasks.description: Decision meeting with the sponsors. Bring the load test result and the open bug list.

tasks.title: Retire the old landing page
tasks.description: Redirect, then remove. Nobody owns this yet.
